questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people are crossing here. Watch for pedestrians in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show the direction of a sharp curve. The arrow points the way the road curves. You may see several of these signs placed along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols or letters. They alert you to hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead. Be prepared for vehicles joining from the side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you what you must and must not do. This sign means parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming curve in the road. Slow down and be prepared to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at one-way street entrances and ramps. It means you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means a specific action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign on a yellow panel means the lane below it leaves the freeway. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for red, yellow, or green lights and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are driving the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Carefully turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign controls traffic movement. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead has limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This regulatory sign means drivers must obey the law it shows. Right turns are forbidden at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up and then swings the arm upward, it signals riders to go faster. This is an important hand signal used in group riding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead where a road joins from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a T intersection ahead. Be ready to turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully and reduce speed to keep control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign means workers may be near the roadway. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Be prepared to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed at this location.
